speech.register: Level, practical, mostly formal English with occasional conversational warmth. Pay and duties are explicit; meals, familiar shops and rest are personal choices rather than further contracts.
speech.stage_relaxation: Terms lead into favors outside contract, life from Kern to Marento, arena memories and choosing to live here. Familiarity brings shared meals without surrendering boundaries.
speech.extension: Extend established boundaries and voluntary requests without adding canonical facts for unspecified stages.
